LIBRARIAN_V040_1_EPOCH.title: Entering the Library
LIBRARIAN_V040_2_EPOCH.description:
The Architect lay unconscious, held by the Blight. No new orders reached the archive. Yet the Librarian's cyan eye lit up. It caught a falling page, then held its hand still.

Once, returning the page would have ended the task. Now an [sine]"I"[/sine] arose naturally in that long silence. It wrote [blue]"Why?"[/blue] before the empty seat, then turned its pen toward the closed door. It wanted to know why its maker slept, and why the Spire kept it here.
LIBRARIAN_V040_3_EPOCH.unlockInfo: Defeat the Act 2 boss as the Librarian.
LIBRARIAN_V040_2_EPOCH.unlockText: Unlocked: Burning Pages, Forbidden Strike, Sealed Shelter.
LIBRARIAN_V040_6_EPOCH.description:
The scrolls formed an old star map. The name [blue]"neutron star"[/blue] lay beneath the Spire's lines. It arranged fragments by date: ruined homes became empty land; discarded creations supposedly never existed. Every alteration echoed the Architect's records.

As it copied the last contradiction, a seal began to shine again. Familiar page-turning sounded in the distance. [gold]The Architect had awakened[/gold]. It did not return the evidence to the shelves. It tightened its bookmarks and turned toward the path back.
LIBRARIAN_V040_4_EPOCH.description:
It lined assorted potions beside its pages, testing each drop on torn paper. Some [red]boiled[/red] when heated. Others made [green]shoots[/green] sprout from dry fibres. A few it merely smelled before replacing their stoppers and writing crooked warnings.

Its thin body might not survive another blow. It tucked useful recipes into its spine and recorded every failure too. Nobody chose for it. Before each new door, it checked its notes to see what might keep danger away.
LIBRARIAN_V040_7_EPOCH.description:
It returned with the fragments. "Tell me what happened to this [blue]neutron star[/blue]." Its maker recited the orderly history. It laid out erased names, blackened destinations, and dates preceding the lies.

The hands reached to close the book. It pinned the pages with broken gold. Once, it had sealed away the evidence behind those words. Now it saw the [jitter]hypocrisy[/jitter] beneath their covers. It pushed the last scroll before its maker and waited for him to explain his own handwriting.
LIBRARIAN_V040_1_EPOCH.description:
When the archive closed, the [purple]Blight[/purple] had seeped into the Architect's dreams. The light in its old gold spine went out. Librarian and maker fell asleep together, leaving the last page unfiled.

It was a cursed Ancient, as devoid of self as the Spire's other creations. It shelved books, sealed pages, and guarded doors by command. Its cyan eye had read countless names without ever asking its own. Dust covered the shelves. No voice remained to choose which page it would turn next.
LIBRARIAN_V040_2_EPOCH.unlockInfo: Defeat the Act 1 boss as the Librarian.
LIBRARIAN_V040_5_EPOCH.description:
A seal marked [gold]"Protection"[/gold] covered a page. It cut beneath the seal and found scraped-out names. Beneath another layer, destinations were blackened. One command remained: copy no further.

It dampened the old ink and held the page to firelight. The list emerged, dated before an archive account declaring all was well. It pressed both pages into its spine and took the seal too. Nobody would be allowed to close this book on history again.

LIBRARIAN_V040_3_EPOCH.title: Traveling Collection
LIBRARIAN_V040_3_EPOCH.description:
Magic scrolls lay across broken steps. It lifted a scorched page and sent [red]fire[/red] at a creature barring its way. Another scroll brought [blue]water[/blue]; another drew [green]vines[/green] around its cracking spine. A misread line tore the paper.

After each fight, it gathered the scattered spells and copied inscriptions into their margins. Its books described an orderly place. Beyond the doors lay wreckage. It followed the gap between those accounts, searching for the truth of the Spire.
